meta.title: Loadline — dispatch, check-calls and invoicing on one board
meta.description: Sample SaaS marketing surface built inside the Cloudflare SaaS Starter. Loadline is a fictional freight dispatch product used to demonstrate the starter's design pipeline.

hero.description: Loadline pulls your load boards, driver check-calls and invoicing into a single dispatch view — so the 4pm scramble is a glance instead of nine browser tabs and a phone tree.
hero.reassurance: Demo data. No credit card, no carrier onboarding, nothing to migrate.

board.title: Tonight's board
board.subtitle: Live check-call ages
board.footer: Sample data — this board is a static demo, not a wired feature.

cost.title: Where the day actually goes
cost.subtitle: The three numbers dispatchers give when asked why the day ran long.

calls.label: On check-calls
calls.description: Per dispatcher, per shift — most of it re-asking where a truck is because the last answer went into a notebook.

tabs.label: Open load boards
tabs.description: Rates in one tab, tracking in another, the customer's portal in a third. Nothing agrees with anything.

invoice.label: To invoice
invoice.description: Paperwork lands late, so cash lands later. The margin you booked is not the margin you keep.

board.title: The board is the product
board.description: Lanes, drivers, ETAs and margin in one row each, sorted by the thing that actually goes wrong: how long it has been since anyone heard from the truck. Rows past 90 minutes surface themselves.
points: One row per load — no drill-down to see status
Check-call age instead of a stale timestamp
Margin visible while you are still deciding

panel.title: Check-call ledger
rows: LL-4794 · app · 6m ago · delivered, BOL attached

invoicing.title: Paperwork closes the load, not the week
invoicing.description: The BOL is attached at delivery, the invoice drafts itself from the rate confirmation, and the load closes the same shift it delivered. No Friday reconciliation ritual.
points: Rate confirmation becomes the invoice draft
BOL captured at delivery, attached to the load
Aging by customer, not by spreadsheet tab

footer.disclaimer: Loadline is a fictional product. This page is a sample marketing surface inside the Cloudflare SaaS Starter, built to demonstrate the design pipeline — every colour on it comes from the starter's existing tokens.
